title: Capacity supply and reservation storage schema
selectedSlice: A â€” capacity-supply + reservation storage schema only
purpose: Define storage primitives required by a later trusted atomic FOOD reservation service without creating supply, performing reservations, creating acceptance evidence, or granting checkout/payment readiness.
findings: FOOD-005D contains exact reservation demand only.
No canonical FOOD model currently owns SKU quantity-on-hand.
No canonical FOOD model currently owns fulfillment-slot capacity.
FOOD-005L is historical acceptance evidence only and requires a later trusted atomic reservation service before acceptance is created.
Reservation rows alone cannot prove available supply or prevent overselling.

skuCapacity.identity: One exact SKU ID/version may have append-only authoritative capacity revisions; identity is exact SKU ID/version/revision.
skuCapacity.semantics: capacity_units is a future trusted-service supplied nonnegative whole SKU-unit capacity. This migration inserts no rows and does not determine capacity.

slotCapacity.identity: One exact method/locationReference/windowReference tuple may have append-only authoritative capacity revisions; identity includes exact revision.
slotCapacity.semantics: capacity_units is future trusted-service supplied nonnegative order-slot capacity. SKU inventory and fulfillment slots remain separate resources.

reservation.identity: One exact FOOD-005E order ID/version + FOOD-005D reservation-request ID/version tuple is globally unique.
reservation.state: Initial schema permits held only. Release/expiration/replacement lifecycles remain deferred.

reservationLines.identity: Exact SKU ID/version demand line within one reservation.

slotReservation.identity: At most one exact fulfillment slot claim per reservation.

constraints: versions and revisions are positive JS-safe integers
capacity and demand quantities are nonnegative/positive bounded integers as appropriate
SKU capacity and fulfillment-slot capacity remain separate
exact order version + reservation-request version identity is unique
reservation demand JSON is opaque canonical evidence, not independently trusted authority
reservation line quantities must be positive
every reservation SKU line binds the exact capacity-source revision used
every fulfillment-slot reservation binds the exact slot-capacity-source revision used
capacity-source histories are append-only and immutable
slot reservation quantity must equal one in this initial schema
reservation lines cascade neither update nor delete
reservation rows and line rows are immutable after insert
capacity source rows are immutable after insert
capacity-source revisions are preserved rather than overwritten
no trigger automatically creates or decrements supply
no trigger automatically creates reservation acceptance
deferred: FOOD-005L acceptance creation after successful atomic reservation
sold quantity and inventory movement accounting
